summary: Backend nodes now share one deterministic Compose runtime, reuse a labelled dependency image, mount source for slice checks, and perform project-scoped cleanup.

checks.name: runtime-name-isolation
checks.details: Names are stable for one checkout, valid and bounded for Compose, and distinct for different checkout paths.

checks.name: duplicate-run-safety
checks.details: A checkout-level file lock rejects a second concurrent backend workflow and releases after completion or failure.

checks.name: source-and-dependency-freshness
checks.details: Policy rebuilds only for Dockerfile or dependency changes and mounts current source for ordinary slice tests.

checks.name: cleanup-scope
checks.details: Cleanup is restricted to the exact Compose project and workflow image label; unfiltered/global prune is forbidden.

checks.name: client-handoff
checks.details: Final backend cleanup retains one current dependency image so frontend and mobile live integration do not rebuild dependencies.

checks.name: validation
checks.details: Python syntax, direct runtime regressions, skill validation, and diff whitespace checks passed.

limitations: The runtime lock uses the POSIX fcntl API supported by the workflow's macOS and Linux Docker environments.
